description: Angular component for managing user security settings, including two-factor authentication and password change.

classes.name: SecurityComponent
classes.description: Angular component for user security management, including 2FA and password change.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, builds forms, loads user data and settings.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions on component destruction.

methods.name: buildTwoFactorForm
methods.description: Constructs the form group for two-factor authentication options.

methods.name: twoFactorLoad
methods.description: Loads 2FA settings for the user and initializes provider options.

methods.name: processTwoFactorAuthConfig
methods.description: Processes and applies 2FA configuration data to the form.

methods.name: buildChangePasswordForm
methods.description: Constructs the form group for password change.

methods.name: loadPasswordPolicy
methods.description: Fetches and applies password policy rules.

methods.name: passwordNotSameAsOld
methods.description: Validator to ensure new password differs from current password.

methods.name: trackByProvider
methods.description: Track function for providers in templates.

methods.name: copyToken
methods.description: Copies JWT token to clipboard and shows notification.

methods.name: confirm2FAChange
methods.description: Handles enabling/disabling 2FA providers with confirmation dialogs.

methods.name: changeDefaultProvider
methods.description: Sets a provider as default for 2FA.

methods.name: providerDataInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info about a specific 2FA provider.

methods.name: onChangePassword
methods.description: Submits password change request and handles errors.

methods.name: openApiKeysTable
methods.description: Opens dialog to display API keys.
